title: Book One · Chapter 134: The Sound in the Side Room
story:
Something knocks inside the side space at night.

Ronan hears it from bed. At first he thinks it is rain. Then he hears three clear knocks. There is a short pause after each one.

He sits up. The window is dark. Mum is asleep. Dad is still putting a clean shirt over the back of a chair.

“Did you hear that?” Ronan whispers.

Dad listens. There it is again.

“Stay in bed. I will look.”

He takes a light and opens their door. Ronan wants to follow. He puts one foot on the floor, then pulls it back under the blanket. Dad has not asked for help.

In the yard Dad calls softly to Mrs Lan. She opens her front door. They talk near the side space. Ronan cannot see the little door from his window. He can only see the light move across the wall.

The sound stops. A moment later Dad laughs.

He comes back carrying the edge of an old cloth.

“The wind,” he says.

“The wind can knock?”

“The wind can move the cloth. Then the cloth knocks on the door. A loose end of the cover was hitting the door.”

“I thought someone was trying to get the books.”

Dad sits on the chair. He does not laugh this time.

“I checked. The door is locked. The boxes are dry.”

Ronan lies down. He listens again. There is only the soft movement of leaves.

In the morning Mr Qiu looks at the cover. One tie has pulled free. “How can I fasten this better?” he asks Dad. He must not fix anything to Mrs Lan's door.

Dad shows him a plain loop around the table leg. He pulls it, checks it, and leaves the rest for Mr Qiu. Ronan helps fold the loose part of the cloth. They spread the whole cloth out. There is more cloth than Ronan thought.

“It wanted to sell pencils at night,” Ronan says.

Mr Qiu looks at the knot. “It did not ask me.”

They leave a little space at the bottom for air. The table stays dry when a light rain comes at noon. The cloth does not hit the door.

Mum looks at the new loop before she goes out. “Can I take the cover off quickly?” she asks. Mr Qiu shows her. She tries it once herself, then puts it back. The knot holds well. Mum can still open it easily. Ronan puts the old loose piece of string in the box for small useful things.

At school Ronan tells Leo about the knocks. “Did you go out alone?” Leo asks.

“Dad went.”

“I would have looked from the window.”

“I did.”

“Did you see anything?”

“A light and a wall.”

Leo looks a little disappointed. He thought Ronan might have seen a stranger. Ronan thought about a stranger too. He is glad Dad only found a loose cloth. Leo does not look as interested now.

He draws the table cover for his own notes. He puts an arrow by the loose end. Under it he writes WHAT MADE THE SOUND. There is no dark man in the drawing. How can he draw wind? He draws the cloth in two places to show its movement.

Mei looks over. “It has two tails.”

“Only when it moves.”

She shows him two little curved lines to put beside the cloth. Now the cloth has only one loose end. The curved lines show it moving. Ronan takes the drawing home. He shows Dad the loose cloth in it. “This kept me awake,” he says.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：loose＝松开的；fasten＝固定好；loop＝绳圈。

情节提示：knot＝绳结；curve / curved＝弯曲的；stranger＝陌生人。

理解：1. 夜里的敲击声从哪里来？2. Ronan 的画为什么没有加入陌生人？
